_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Stable Story#000.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} の外で Enkser と話す

Stable Story#001.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers! Preferably with no friends or family, but I'm not picky!
Stable Story#001.dst: 体力自慢の冒険者募集！友達も家族もいないと尚よし、でも贅沢は言わないよ！
Stable Story#001.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#002.src: You see, I'm a horse merchant. Make my living selling these beauties to adventurers like you.
Stable Story#002.dst: 実は私は馬商人でね。この美しい馬たちを君みたいな冒険者に売って暮らしてる。
Stable Story#002.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#003.src: I work at this barn, selling the horses I raise in {p} out here to rich {p} folk.
Stable Story#003.dst: この納屋で、{p} で育てた馬を、ここ {p} の金持ちに売ってるんだ。
Stable Story#003.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#004.src: Until these rabble-rousing troublemakers blew a tunnel through my barn and smuggled MY horses out.
Stable Story#004.dst: ところが騒ぎ好きの厄介者どもが納屋を爆破してトンネルを開け、私の馬を運び出したんだ。
Stable Story#004.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#005.src: Usually, I'd be charging a high price for these horses Not to be rude, but one you couldn't afford.
Stable Story#005.dst: 普段ならこの馬には高値をつけるところだ。失礼ながら、君には払えない額でね。
Stable Story#005.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#006.src: So, let's cut a deal They stole my stable key. If you can go to my barn in {p}...
Stable Story#006.dst: そこで取引だ。奴らに厩舎の鍵を盗まれた。{p} の私の納屋に行って…
Stable Story#006.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#007.src: And return the key to me, I'll so charitably bestow upon you one of my horses. This deal is sweeter than you realize, too...
Stable Story#007.dst: …鍵を取り戻してくれたら、なんと寛大にも馬を一頭進呈しよう。この取引、君が思うよりずっとお得だよ…
Stable Story#007.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#008.src: Betty'll be there to help! Strong as she is, don't you DARE let them touch her!
Stable Story#008.dst: Betty が手伝ってくれる！力持ちだけど、絶対に奴らに触らせるなよ！
Stable Story#008.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#009.src: I'll be making my way to {p} myself to ensure Betty's safety.
Stable Story#009.dst: Betty の無事を確かめに、私も {p} へ向かうよ。
Stable Story#009.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#010.src: Now, best be on your way. {p} is a fair bit down the {p} from here, off to the east.
Stable Story#010.dst: さあ、出発したまえ。{p} はここから {p} を東へしばらく行った所だ。
Stable Story#010.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#011.src: Bring back [{~} Stable Key] to Enkser from the tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Stable Story#011.dst: [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] のトンネルから [{~1} Stable Key] を Enkser に持ち帰る

Stable Story#012.src: Hey, have you found my [{~} Stable Key] yet? It should be somewhere in {p} to the east.
Stable Story#012.dst: やあ、[{~} Stable Key] は見つかったかい？東の {p} のどこかにあるはずだ。
Stable Story#012.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#013.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers, preferably with no friends or
Stable Story#013.dst: 体力自慢の冒険者募集、友達も家族も
Stable Story#013.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#014.src: Hey, it's you! Got my barn key yet?
Stable Story#014.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#015.src: Ah, god bless. And I presume Betty did all the work while you just lounged around.
Stable Story#015.dst: おお、ありがたい。どうせ Betty が全部働いて、君はのんびりしてたんだろう。
Stable Story#015.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#016.src: Hm. Cows, huh? Ah who knows!? Life is full of mysterious, huh?
Stable Story#016.dst: ふむ。牛、だって？まあ誰にわかる！？人生は謎だらけだね？
Stable Story#016.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#017.src: Either way. As the great bovine above is my witness if I see the smallest bruise I will
Stable Story#017.dst: ともかく。天の偉大なる牛に誓って、少しでも痣を見つけたら私は
Stable Story#017.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#018.src: Nevermind all that. A horse I promised, and a horse you shall have. Much thanks to you.
Stable Story#018.dst: まあそれはいい。約束どおり馬をやろう、受け取りたまえ。本当にありがとう。
Stable Story#018.speaker: Enkser
